# awscc_athena_system_tables (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Athena::SystemTables



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the configuration was created, set by the service.
- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer managed AWS KMS key used to encrypt the system table data. Specify a key ARN (not an alias); the key must be in the same account and Region. The encryption choice is permanent for the account and Region: it cannot be changed or removed after creation, and it persists after this resource is deleted.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The time the configuration was last modified, set by the service.
- `table_name` (String) The reserved keyword identifying the account-level System Tables configuration. The only accepted value is ALL, which enables all system tables for the account. This is the resource's primary identifier.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the system tables configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.
